title: Service, Solidarity, and Self-Help: A Comparative Topic Modeling Analysis of Community Unionism in the Boot and Shoe Union and Unite Community
abstract: arXiv:2509.01529v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper presents a comparative analysis of community unionism (CU) in two distinct historical and organizational contexts: the National Boot and Shoe Union (B\&S) in the 1920s and Unite Community in the 2010s--2020s. Using BERTopic for thematic modeling and cTF-IDF weighting, alongside word frequency analysis, the study examines the extent to which each union's discourse aligns with key features of CU -- such as coalition-building, grassroots engagement, and action beyond the workplace. The results reveal significant differences in thematic focus and discursive coherence. While Unite Community demonstrates stronger alignment with outward-facing, social justice-oriented themes, the B\&S corpus emphasizes internal administration, industrial relations, and member services -- reflecting a more traditional, servicing-oriented union model. translated_title: 服务、团结与互助：制鞋工会与Unite Community社区工会主义的比较主题建模分析
translated_abstract: 本文对两个不同历史和组织背景下的社区工会主义（CU）进行了比较分析：20世纪20年代的全国制鞋工会（B&S）以及2010年代至2020年代的Unite Community。研究采用BERTopic进行主题建模并结合cTF-IDF加权，辅以词频分析，考察了各工会的话语在多大程度上契合社区工会主义的关键特征——如联盟构建、基层参与以及工作场所之外的行动。研究结果揭示了两者在主题焦点和话语连贯性上的显著差异：Unite Community与外向型、社会正义导向的主题表现出更强的契合性，而B&S语料库则强调内部行政、劳资关系和会员服务——反映出一种更为传统的、以服务为导向的工会模式。该分析还提供了方法论层面的洞见，展示了现代自然语言处理技术如何……
tldr: 本研究运用BERTopic主题建模方法，对比分析了1920年代全国制鞋工会与2010-2020年代Unite Community的社区工会主义话语，发现Unite Community更契合外向型、社会正义导向的社区工会特征，而制鞋工会则体现了传统的服务型工会模式。
en_tdlr: Using BERTopic topic modeling, this study comparatively analyzes the community unionism discourse of the 1920s National Boot and Shoe Union versus Unite Community (2010s–2020s), finding that Unite Community aligns more strongly with outward-facing, social justice-oriented themes, while the Boot and Shoe Union reflects a more traditional, servicing-oriented union model.
